tasks.title: Implement errors, templates, request/representation models, secure rendering, and message building
tasks.red_command: uv run pytest tests/acceptance/mail/ tests/property/mail/ tests/unit/mail/ tests/contract/mail/ tests/integration/mail/ -v
implementation_steps: Create src/backend/mail/errors.py with the exception hierarchy rooted at MailError: MailConfigurationError(reason), MailTransportError(reason), MailTemplateError(reason); all messages secret-free (error kind + short reason only; never the SMTP password, a token, or the email body) (D8, ADR-045)

Create src/backend/mail/templates.py with EmailTemplate (frozen Pydantic model: name min_length=1, subject, body_html, body_text; all with {{variable}} placeholders; both body_html and body_text required because the message is always multipart/alternative) and the module-level constants PASSWORD_RESET_TEMPLATE (name='password_reset', placeholders {{display_name}}, {{reset_url}}) and EMAIL_VERIFICATION_TEMPLATE (name='email_verification', placeholders {{display_name}}, {{verification_url}}) (D2)

Create src/backend/mail/models.py with the request schemas (schema-level validation; violations raise pydantic.ValidationError): PasswordResetEmailRequest (to EmailStr, display_name 1..320, reset_url 1..2048), EmailVerificationEmailRequest (to EmailStr, display_name 1..320, verification_url 1..2048), and the representation EmailSendResult (frozen; to, template) (D11)

Create src/backend/mail/render.py with render_template(template, context) -> RenderedTemplate (subject, body_html, body_text): each {{variable}} is replaced with the corresponding context value, HTML-escaped (html.escape); a {{variable}} with no corresponding context value raises MailTemplateError (reason 'missing_variable:<name>'); a malformed template (a {{ without a closing }}) raises MailTemplateError (reason 'malformed_template'); rendering is deterministic (INV-001, INV-002) (D3, ADR-044)

Create src/backend/mail/message.py with build_message(to, rendered, from_name, from_address) -> EmailMessage: a multipart/alternative message (text + HTML) with the From header set to 'from_name <from_address>'; and validate_recipient(to) using email-validator that raises MailTemplateError (reason 'invalid_recipient') for an invalid recipient (REQ-017, REQ-008)
Export the public API from src/backend/mail/__init__.py (errors, EmailTemplate, built-in templates, request/representation models, render_template, build_message)
tasks.green_command: uv run pytest tests/acceptance/mail/ tests/property/mail/ tests/unit/mail/ tests/contract/mail/ tests/integration/mail/ -v
design_constraints: The template is trusted; only the substituted context values are HTML-escaped (D3, ADR-044)
Rendering is deterministic (INV-001) and XSS-safe: context values never reach the rendered output with raw <, >, &, ", or ' (INV-002)
Error messages are secret-free: error kind + short reason only (D8, ADR-045, NFR-002)
The message is always multipart/alternative (text + HTML); both body_html and body_text are required (D2, REQ-017)
Schema-level validation violations raise pydantic.ValidationError (D11); service-level failures raise the MailError hierarchy
completion_gates: Acceptance tests for AC-008, AC-009, AC-010, AC-019 pass
Property tests for INV-001, INV-002 pass
Unit tests for EDGE-001, EDGE-002, EDGE-003 pass

tasks.title: Implement settings registration (feature_settings.py) and live config resolution
tasks.red_command: uv run pytest tests/acceptance/mail/ tests/property/mail/ tests/unit/mail/ tests/contract/mail/ tests/integration/mail/ -v
implementation_steps: Create src/backend/mail/feature_settings.py with register_settings(registry) (traced with @logged(slow_threshold_ms=5)) registering the 8 SettingDefinitions with category='application', group='mail': mail.smtp_host (TEXT, default 'localhost'), mail.smtp_port (NUMBER, default 587, min_value=1, max_value=65535), mail.smtp_username (TEXT, default ''), mail.smtp_password (TEXT, default ''), mail.smtp_from (EMAIL, default 'no-reply@example.com'), mail.smtp_tls (BOOLEAN, default True), mail.smtp_timeout (NUMBER, default 30, min_value=1), mail.from_name (TEXT, default 'Python Template') (REQ-001, ADR-036)

Add _read_setting(registry, key, fallback) (live read; an unregistered key returns the fallback) and resolve_mail_config() -> MailConfig (host, port, username, password, use_tls, timeout, from_name, from_address): read live from get_settings_registry(required=False) on each call; when the registry does not exist or a key is unregistered, fall back to the hardcoded defaults (REQ-002, ADR-037)
Export register_settings from __init__.py
tasks.green_command: uv run pytest tests/acceptance/mail/ tests/property/mail/ tests/unit/mail/ tests/contract/mail/ tests/integration/mail/ -v
design_constraints: No import side effects: register_settings is an explicit function called at wiring time, not at import (ADR-036)
Settings are read live on each use (get_value per read), so a set_value affects a running service without re-construction (ADR-037)
Unregistered settings fall back to the hardcoded defaults (REQ-002)
mail.smtp_password is sensitive: it is a registered value, never a log/event payload (NFR-002)
AC-002/AC-003 are verified at the config-resolution level (resolve_mail_config is the live read the service performs on each send); the service-level live read is re-verified in T-004
completion_gates: Acceptance tests for AC-001, AC-002, AC-003 pass

tasks.title: Implement the SmtpTransport ABC and the smtplib-backed SmtpTransportImpl
tasks.red_command: uv run pytest tests/acceptance/mail/ tests/property/mail/ tests/unit/mail/ tests/contract/mail/ tests/integration/mail/ -v
implementation_steps: Create src/backend/mail/transport.py with the SmtpTransport ABC (abstract send(message: EmailMessage) -> None; raises MailTransportError on failure) (D1, ADR-043)

Implement SmtpTransportImpl(host, port, username, password, use_tls, timeout): send opens the SMTP connection (TLS when use_tls is true), authenticates when username is non-empty, sends the message, and closes (per send; no long-lived connection) (D13, ADR-046)

Wrap failures in MailTransportError with a secret-free reason: connection refused / DNS failure (ConnectionRefusedError, socket.gaierror, OSError) -> 'connection'; SMTPAuthenticationError -> 'authentication'; other smtplib.SMTPException -> 'smtp'; socket.timeout / socket.timeouterror -> 'timeout' (D8, ADR-045)
The SMTP password is never included in the error, in any log, or in any event (NFR-002)
Export SmtpTransport and SmtpTransportImpl from __init__.py
tasks.green_command: uv run pytest tests/acceptance/mail/ tests/property/mail/ tests/unit/mail/ tests/contract/mail/ tests/integration/mail/ -v
design_constraints: The service references only the SmtpTransport ABC; the SMTP backend must be swappable (D1, ADR-043)
Per-send connection: open, send, close (no long-lived connection, no pool) (D13, ADR-046)
Errors are secret-free: the reason string only, never the SMTP password (D8, NFR-002)
The standard library smtplib is used (no new third-party SMTP dependency)
completion_gates: Unit tests for EDGE-005, EDGE-006, EDGE-007, EDGE-008 pass

tasks.title: Implement MailService core: send_email (validate -> render -> build -> config -> send -> event)
tasks.red_command: uv run pytest tests/acceptance/mail/ tests/property/mail/ tests/unit/mail/ tests/contract/mail/ tests/integration/mail/ -v
implementation_steps: Create src/backend/mail/events.py with MailEvent (frozen; occurred_at default datetime.now(UTC)) + EmailSent(to, template) + EmailFailed(to, template, reason: 'template' | 'configuration' | 'transport'); non-sensitive data only (D9)

Create src/backend/mail/service.py with MailService(transport: SmtpTransport | None = None, event_bus: EventPublisher | None = None); a None transport builds a SmtpTransportImpl from the live settings on each send (D1, D13, ADR-043, ADR-046); a None publisher means no events (no error)

Implement send_email(to, template, context) -> EmailSendResult: validate the recipient (MailTemplateError) -> render the template (MailTemplateError) -> build a multipart/alternative EmailMessage with the From header from the mail.from_name / mail.smtp_from settings (REQ-017) -> resolve the SMTP configuration live (an empty host raises MailConfigurationError, reason 'smtp_host_empty') -> send via the transport (MailTransportError) -> publish EmailSent; on a MailError publish EmailFailed (kind 'template' | 'configuration' | 'transport') and re-raise the MailError (REQ-003, REQ-010, REQ-011, REQ-012)
Feature-specific emails: a feature provides its own EmailTemplate and calls the core send_email operation (REQ-006, D6)
Trace MailService with @logged_class(slow_threshold_ms=5000, include_args=False) (REQ-014, ADR-047)
Export MailService, MailEvent, EmailSent, EmailFailed from __init__.py
tasks.green_command: uv run pytest tests/acceptance/mail/ tests/property/mail/ tests/unit/mail/ tests/contract/mail/ tests/integration/mail/ -v
design_constraints: Each send is independent: the transport is created per send, no long-lived connection, no per-send mutable state (D13, ADR-046)
Events carry non-sensitive data only: no email body, no rendered subject, no token, no SMTP password (D9, REQ-013, NFR-002)
EmailFailed is published and the MailError is re-raised (REQ-012); a None event bus means no events and no error (EDGE-009)
include_args=False: the SMTP password and tokens never appear in log records (REQ-014, ADR-047)
The SMTP password never appears in the returned EmailSendResult, the raised error's message, or the published events (INV-003, INV-004)
completion_gates: Acceptance tests for AC-004, AC-007, AC-011, AC-012, AC-013, AC-014, AC-015 pass
Unit tests for EDGE-004, EDGE-009, EDGE-010 pass
Property tests for INV-003, INV-004, INV-005 pass

implementation_steps: Verify thread safety: each send is independent (the transport is created per send; no shared mutable state), so concurrent sends from multiple threads are safe (REQ-016, NFR-005, ADR-046)

Create tests/contract/mail/test_performance.py with test_nfr_001_preparation_performance_budget: email preparation (template rendering + message building) completes in <= 50 ms at p95 on local hardware with the shared logging feature at its default INFO level (the SMTP delivery time is not budgeted) (NFR-001)

Create tests/contract/mail/test_secrets.py with test_nfr_002_no_secrets_in_logs_or_events: the SMTP password never appears in log records, events, or error messages; the email body (containing tokens) never appears in events; template context values are HTML-escaped in the rendered output (NFR-002)

Create tests/acceptance/mail/test_public_api.py with test_ac_017_public_api_stable and tests/contract/mail/test_public_api.py with test_nfr_003_public_api_stable: the public API of backend.mail (service, request/representation models, error hierarchy, transport ABC, events, built-in templates) is present and a backward-compatibility contract (REQ-015, NFR-003)

Create tests/acceptance/mail/test_logging.py with test_ac_016_no_secrets_in_log_records and tests/contract/mail/test_logging.py with test_nfr_004_service_traced: the service is traced with @logged_class (include_args=False, slow_threshold_ms=5000); no log record contains the SMTP password or a token (REQ-014, NFR-004)

Create tests/acceptance/mail/test_concurrency.py with test_ac_018_concurrent_send and tests/integration/mail/test_concurrency.py with test_nfr_005_concurrent_send_thread_safety: send_email called concurrently from multiple threads — every send is independent and no thread crashes (REQ-016, NFR-005)
tasks.green_command: uv run pytest tests/acceptance/mail/ tests/property/mail/ tests/unit/mail/ tests/contract/mail/ tests/integration/mail/ -v
design_constraints: The public API is a backward-compatibility contract (REQ-015, NFR-003)
